name: Oyamel fir
desc: A cloud-forest conifer of central Mexican mountains. Overwintering monarchs gather in its forests, and UNESCO says keeping the standing forest and its microclimates is the key management need.
about: Abies religiosa, the oyamel fir or sacred fir, (known as oyamel in Spanish) is a fir native to the mountains of central and southern Mexico and western Guatemala.
